data.name: Noa
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Hebrew word ‘noah’ meaning rest, comfort, or peace. In the Old Testament, Noa was the name of a woman who, along with her husband, was saved from the Great Flood. Her name is also mentioned in the New Testament as a descendant of Jesus.

data.cultural_impact: The name Noa holds significance in Jewish culture as it is associated with one of the most famous figures in Jewish history, Noah, who is revered for his righteousness and obedience to God. In other cultures and communities, Noa is also used as a given name and remains popular due to its meaning of comfort and peace.

It is a name that inspires faith, hope, and trust in the face of adversity, as demonstrated by the story of Noah's Ark. Additionally, it is a name that can serve as a reminder of God's promise to always be present with His people, offering comfort and rest in times of need.
